metadata.title: La Vineria di Montepulciano
metadata.description: Two rooms on Via di Gracciano nel Corso, a cellar cut into the tufa, and the family's own wine. In Montepulciano you eat on top of the history.
metadata.ogAlt: La Vineria di Montepulciano, the Ercolani family

brand.tagline: The table above. The centuries below.
brand.concetto: In Montepulciano you sit above the history, and drink what was made beneath your feet.

kitchenSink.intro: This page is not part of the public site. It gathers every token and every state of the primitives, so that building sections is composition rather than invention.

palette.nota: Every pair reports its WCAG 2.1 contrast ratio, calculated rather than estimated.
palette.esitoAALarge: AA — large text or non-text elements only

tipografia.nota: The contrast between tight display and wide labels is what drives the whole design.
tipografia.esempioLead: You go down a narrow staircase and the air changes at once: under Montepulciano the stone is cool and porous, and it holds the damp the way a church does.
tipografia.esempioBody: The cellar is not a set piece. It is where the family's wine rests, well below the room where you drink it. The way down is short and steep, and worth taking.

movimento.nota: Four curves and four durations, one per register. Matter does not move the way an interface does.

primitive.nota: Every component in all of its states: default, hover, focus, pressed, disabled, error.

famiglia.titolo: We grew up together on these hills
famiglia.p1: We are a team of young friends who grew up together in the Tuscan hills, and our love for this land is our compass.
famiglia.p2: La Vineria is how we share the beauty and the honesty of these places. No frills: a sincere welcome and a family atmosphere.

cantina.titolo:
The cellar cannot be photographed.

You go down to it.
cantina.sottotesto: Below the room at 101 the tufa is cool and porous, and the medieval tunnels can be visited. It is where the family wine rests: the stair is narrow, the way is short, and it is worth the descent.
cantina.dato: Medieval tunnels · Open to visits · Entrance at 101

vino.titolo: The house label is called Il Brillo
vino.p1: It is the wine the family makes, and it is open in both rooms.
vino.p2: The rest of the list comes from small growers nearby: we guide you through the choice and the pairing, and we tell you the story of every bottle.

cucina.testo: We choose our ingredients carefully, favouring small local producers. The boards are built at the counter, in front of you.
